title: Qualified Leapfrog family addendum
description: Source-backed walk/replay and editable arithmetic mechanisms. Missing fast mappings keep these rules blocked.

definitions.payload: The field arithmetic carried by the inversion walk.

evidence.symbol: AP1270 pinned source and source recipe, when installed

rules.title: Group signed arithmetic updates
rules.description: Leapfrog changes the order of GCD walk steps and payload updates. Grouped updates can reduce the number of simultaneously live registers.

mechanism.match: Separate signed walk and payload operations at an admitted boundary.
mechanism.replace: A dependency-valid grouped update and its matching inverse.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

evidence.symbol: AP1270 pinned source and source recipe, when installed

rules.title: Edit a replay arithmetic program
rules.description: The earlier Rust backend exposes one to eight typed instructions at owned replay boundaries. Each candidate must preserve the field map, phase, and scratch contract.

mechanism.replace: A typed add/sub/half/double/half_u/double_u/swap program and reversed inverse.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

evidence.symbol: AP1270 pinned source and source recipe, when installed

notes: This release records the arithmetic program language. Its earlier full-width implementation has not been mapped into the fast16 constructor.

rules.title: Adjust the walk and repair budget
rules.description: A walk budget trades retained state and gate count against exceptional arithmetic inputs. Freeze each candidate before a fresh reliability audit.

mechanism.match: A source-bound walk, replay, or comparison budget.
mechanism.replace: Another admitted setting with a new full-circuit audit.

rules.title: Use a sparse signed constant kernel
rules.description: A signed power-of-two decomposition can replace a dense constant update. The same modulus and arithmetic width must apply to every term.

mechanism.replace: The same value map from verified signed powers of two.
